text.content:
The trains, which run on time. That scares people.

Kind: Public transit
Base: Owned by Night Corp since 2068; controlled from the basement of Night Corp HQ
Purpose: Eight lines, six running, 18 hours a day. 2eb a ride, 100eb a month

Night Corp bought Night City's transit system in 2068, after a series of poison gas attacks in the subway, and runs it on time. A single ride is 2eb and the monthly pass 100eb; trains run 18 hours a day. There is no service in Combat Zones, and the Pacifica Line has been suspended since the war.

Lines, 2070

  • 1 Northern Line: All Foods to Parque del Mar, through Little China, Little Europe and the University. The NorCal Gate spur is closed by the Arasaka perimeter.
  • 2 Crosstown: Industrial North to Ash St, through Kabuki, Japantown and Heywood Docks. Gangers ride free; nobody checks.
  • 3 Central Loop: Corporate Plaza, Little Europe, the Glen, Silk Road and Japantown. The cleanest trains in the city.
  • 4 Star Line: Morro Rock Blvd to the Columbarium, through Corporate Plaza, Japantown and North Oak Gate. The NCX extension opens in 2072.
  • 5 Westbrook Express: Japantown to Industrial North through Charter Hill. A corporate shuttle at rush hour.
  • 6 Business Connect: Waterfront to NCX. Planned, and paid for by Arasaka.
  • 7 Pacifica Line: Glen South to West Wind and the Stadium spur. Suspended since the war; its stations are squats.
  • 8 Southern Line: Port to East Bay Terminal, through the Glen and Arroyo. Freight and shift workers.

Rush hour runs weekdays 7–9 and 5–7. The last Central Loop train leaves Little Europe at two.

Edgerunner's Handbook p.30; Night City 2070 (The Unification Era), ch.01
